name: West of House
description: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door. There is a small mailbox here. The opening of Zork: circle the house, find a way in, and see what lies beneath the rug.

player.name: Adventurer
player.description: An adventurer of uncertain background and excellent taste in mailboxes.

rooms.name: West of House
rooms.description: You are standing in an open field west of a white house. The front door is boarded shut, and whoever did it was thorough about it. A small mailbox stands nearby. Paths lead around the house to the north and south, and a forest rises to the west.

fixtures.name: Small Mailbox
fixtures.description: A small mailbox on a wooden post, its flag down and its paint flaking.

fixtures.name: Leaflet
fixtures.description: A leaflet tucked inside the mailbox. It reads: "WELCOME TO ZORK! ZORK is a game of adventure, danger, and low cunning."

fixtures.name: Boarded Door
fixtures.description: The front door of the house, nailed over with weathered planks. It is not going to open.

rooms.name: North of House
rooms.description: You are facing the north side of the white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded. A narrow path winds north into the trees, and the path around the house continues west and east.

fixtures.name: Boarded Windows
fixtures.description: Planks nailed across every window. Someone wanted very much to keep something in or out.

rooms.name: South of House
rooms.description: You are facing the south side of the white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded. The path around the house continues west and east.

fixtures.name: Boarded Windows
fixtures.description: More boarded windows. The house is consistent, at least.

rooms.name: Behind House
rooms.description: You are behind the white house. In one corner of the house there is a small window, and unlike every other opening in this house, it is slightly ajar. Paths lead around the house to the north and south.

rooms.name: Forest
rooms.description: This is a forest, with trees in all directions. To the east there appears to be sunlight, and the edge of a field. Every other direction looks exactly like this one.

fixtures.name: Trees
fixtures.description: Tall, old, and identical. Wandering among them would be a fine way to get lost.

rooms.name: Forest Path
rooms.description: This is a path winding through a dimly lit forest. One particularly large tree with some low branches stands at the edge of the path. The path runs south toward the house and north toward a clearing.

fixtures.name: Large Tree
fixtures.description: A huge tree with low branches that practically ask to be climbed.

rooms.name: Up a Tree
rooms.description: You are about ten feet above the ground, nestled among some large branches. The nearest branch above you is out of reach. Beside you on the branch is a small bird's nest.

fixtures.name: Bird's Nest
fixtures.description: A small nest woven from twigs and grass. In it sits a large egg encrusted with precious jewels, apparently scavenged by a childless songbird.

fixtures.name: Jewel-Encrusted Egg
fixtures.description: A large egg covered in jewels, with a delicate gold clasp along one side. It is closed, and looks like it would not survive careless handling.

rooms.name: Clearing
rooms.description: You are in a clearing, with a forest surrounding you on all sides. A path leads south. On the ground is a pile of leaves.

fixtures.name: Pile of Leaves
fixtures.description: A heap of damp autumn leaves. It looks as though something might be underneath.

fixtures.name: Grating
fixtures.description: An iron grating set into the ground. It is locked, and judging by the lock, it opens from below.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads west, a dark staircase leads upward, and a dark chimney leads down. To the east is a small window which is open.

fixtures.name: Kitchen Table
fixtures.description: A sturdy table, recently used for preparing food.

fixtures.name: Brown Sack
fixtures.description: An elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers. It is folded shut.

fixtures.name: Glass Bottle
fixtures.description: A clear glass bottle on the table, with a quantity of water inside.

fixtures.name: Chimney
fixtures.description: A dark, narrow chimney. Too narrow to climb while carrying much of anything.

rooms.name: Attic
rooms.description: This is the attic. The only exit is a stairway leading down. A large coil of rope is lying in the corner, and on a table is a nasty-looking knife.

fixtures.name: Coil of Rope
fixtures.description: A large coil of sturdy rope. It looks long enough to be useful somewhere deep.

fixtures.name: Nasty Knife
fixtures.description: A knife with a wicked edge, resting on a small table.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.description: You are in the living room. There is a doorway to the east, a wooden door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be nailed shut, and a trophy case. A large oriental rug lies in the center of the room. Above the trophy case hangs an elvish sword of great antiquity, and a battery-powered brass lantern sits on the case.

fixtures.name: Trophy Case
fixtures.description: A glass case, conspicuously empty. It expects to be filled with treasures.

fixtures.name: Oriental Rug
fixtures.description: A heavy, beautiful rug, worn thin in a rectangle near its centre. It does not lie quite flat.

fixtures.name: Wooden Door
fixtures.description: A wooden door covered in strange gothic lettering. It is nailed firmly shut.

fixtures.name: Elvish Sword
fixtures.description: An elvish sword of great antiquity, hanging above the trophy case. Its blade glows faintly when danger is near.

fixtures.name: Brass Lantern
fixtures.description: A battery-powered brass lantern, sitting on the trophy case.

rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.description: You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north and a crawlway to the south. A steep metal ramp rises to the west, too slippery to climb. Above you, the trap door you came through.

fixtures.name: Metal Ramp
fixtures.description: A steep, slick metal ramp. You are not going to get up it.

fixtures.name: Narrow Passageway
fixtures.description: A narrow passage leading north into the dark. From somewhere beyond comes an unpleasant smell, and possibly a grunt.

doors.name: Northwest Path
doors.description: A narrow path curling around the northwest corner of the house, between the open field and the north side.

doors.name: Southwest Path
doors.description: A narrow path curling around the southwest corner of the house, between the open field and the south side.

doors.name: Forest Edge
doors.description: Where the open field west of the house gives way to the trees. Sunlight marks the field side.

doors.name: Northeast Path
doors.description: The path around the northeast corner of the house, between the north side and the back.

doors.name: Southeast Path
doors.description: The path around the southeast corner of the house, between the south side and the back.

doors.name: Forest Trail
doors.description: A narrow trail between the north side of the house and the dim forest path to the north.

doors.name: Clearing Trail
doors.description: The trail running north from the forest path into a clearing.

doors.name: Low Branches
doors.description: The low branches of the large tree beside the forest path, close enough to climb up into or down from.

doors.name: Kitchen Window
doors.description: A small window in the back corner of the house, between the yard behind it and the kitchen. It is just wide enough to climb through.

doors.name: Kitchen Passage
doors.description: A short passage joining the kitchen and the living room.

doors.name: Dark Staircase
doors.description: A dark staircase climbing from the kitchen up into the attic.

doors.name: Trap Door
doors.description: A dusty trap door in the living room floor, opening onto a dark cellar below. From above, the oriental rug hides it completely.
